instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up. Inside a boxing gym with black punching bags, the bearded man with a braided mohawk (R2) in a black t-shirt stands on the left, facing right. He uses his tattooed right hand to guide the raised black boxing glove of the woman with braided hair (R1), who stands on the right wearing a black strapless top. In the background, a blurred bystander in dark clothing is visible. Soft overhead lighting casts a cool tone over the training session.
